title: 第15章 宿敌相见第16章 真龙秘境开启
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 噗啊
随着时间的流逝，真龙秘境外都是一滩滩血水，数百名修士都极其痛苦的跪在地上，风云帝国的人也早已支撑不住掉落于地面，八个锦衣卫已经有五个锦衣卫化为血水
一旁的叶辰也支撑不住的趴在地面，艰难的看着虚空上的八头上古麒麟和那座宏伟的宫殿，眼神中透露着杀意，恨不得冲上去灭了虚空上的凌浩众人
而天老也因为透支灵魂力而回到戒指中
这时又有数名修士化成血水
虚空上的上古麒麟依旧不断的散发威压玩弄下面的修士，凶恶的脸庞露出戏弄的神情，但凡认真一点，下面的修士瞬间化为血水
“可恶，竟然在玩弄我等”
真龙秘境外的修士艰难的看着上古麒麟咬牙切齿的道
但奈何没有一丝办法，别上冲上跟它们打了，现在就连起身都做不到，谈何动手？
吼~
风云帝国的千年蛟龙此时口吐鲜血痛苦的哀嚎着，近百米的身体早已透支，身上的鳞片更是被压到变形，身上到处是血，就连头上的角也被压到出现裂痕，可以说是体无完肤
“不好蛟龙快撑不住了”
薛统领看着蛟龙道
于是将蛟龙收入灵兽乾坤袋中，这才人蛟龙捡回一条命，不然再过几秒，此时的蛟龙也会被压成血水
“可恶，上面的人到底是何方神圣？”
风雪玲艰难的支撑在地面看着虚空上的宫殿，嘴角不断的流出鲜血
宫殿内
“帝一，我们到了吗？”
此时凌浩缓缓的睁开双眼道，身上的气息比在真武圣地的时候再攀升一层楼，无形的威压瞬间笼罩整个宫殿
“回神子，我们已经到了真龙秘境，现在下面聚集大量的修士”
帝一瞬移来到宫殿中央恭敬的道，并察觉到了此时凌浩身上的变化，比下界之前更强了，内心也是无比的高兴，凌浩越强凌家就越强大，称霸整个三千大世界指日可待
“好，我们下去吧，让麒麟别玩了”
凌浩缓缓的起身道
随后帝一出现在宫殿外，看着下面两座百丈高山中间的秘境，以及秘境之外的修士
而后拍了拍麒麟，这才使八头上古麒麟安静下来，身上的威压也随着散去
而此时的真龙秘境外
“呼啊，呼~终于.....终于能松口气了”
威压散去后，下面的修士顿时才得以喘上气，倒在地面上，头上依旧还在不断的冒汗
有的嗑药调息，有的开始修炼内功功法调节身体
“太好了，这可怕的威压终于散去了，再过一会儿恐怕我都要支撑不住了”
角落的叶辰此时也艰难的站起身来道，然后将储物戒里的丹药吃下，然后开始盘坐调养，随着体内灵气不断聚集丹田，戒指中的灵魂力才得到补充，并滋养着沉睡的天老
“现在当务之急是让天老苏醒，不然一会真龙秘境开启就不好办了”
“六公主，您没事吧”
薛统领将风雪玲扶起来道，内心是十分的不安，要是风雪玲有个三长两短，他得提头去见帝君
“我没事，谢谢薛统领”
风雪玲喘着气站起来道，并看向周围，随后再看虚空上的宫殿
而宫殿之上，站立着一个身穿金甲的人，浑身散发着无比强烈的金光，如同一个太阳
“不知阁下是何方势力，小女子乃是风云帝国的六公主，风雪玲”
风雪玲恭敬的对宫殿上的帝一道，心里是极其忐忑不安
content_en:
Poof
As time goes by, there are pools of blood outside the True Dragon Secret Realm. Hundreds of monks are kneeling on the ground in extreme pain. People from the Fengyun Empire can no longer hold up and fall to the ground. Five of the eight Jinyi guards have turned into blood.
Ye Chen on the side couldn't hold himself up and lay on the ground, looking hard at the eight-headed ancient unicorn and the magnificent palace in the void. His eyes revealed murderous intent, and he wanted to rush up and destroy Ling Hao and everyone in the void.
And Tianlao also returned to the ring because of overdraft of soul power.
At this time, several monks turned into blood
The ancient unicorn in the void still continued to exude coercion and toy with the monks below. Its ferocious face showed a teasing look. If it were serious, the monks below would instantly turn into blood.
"Damn it, you're actually playing tricks on me."
The monks outside the True Dragon Secret Realm looked hard at the ancient Qilin's gritted teeth.
But there is no way around it. Don't rush up and fight them. Now that you can't even get up, how can you do anything?
Roar~
The Millennium Dragon of Fengyun Empire was vomiting blood and wailing in pain. The nearly 100-meter-long body was already overstretched, and the scales on its body were compressed to the point of deformation. There was blood everywhere on its body, and even the horns on its head were compressed to the point of cracks. It could be said that it was completely damaged.
"Sorry, Jiaolong can't hold it any longer."
Commander Xue looked at Jiaolong and said
So he put the dragon into the spirit beast's universe bag. Only then did the dragon save his life. Otherwise, in a few seconds, the dragon would have been crushed into blood.
"Damn it, who are the people above?"
Feng Xueling struggled to support herself on the ground and looked at the palace in the void, with blood constantly flowing from the corners of her mouth.
inside the palace
"Diyi, are we here?"
At this time, Ling Hao slowly opened his eyes and said, the aura on his body was higher than when he was in the Zhenwu Holy Land, and the invisible pressure instantly enveloped the entire palace.
"Back to Shenzi, we have arrived at the True Dragon Secret Realm, and there are a large number of monks gathered below."
Di Yi teleported to the center of the palace and said respectfully, and noticed the changes in Ling Hao at this time. He was stronger than before in the lower world, and he was extremely happy in his heart. The stronger Ling Hao is, the stronger the Ling family will be, and he will soon dominate the entire three thousand worlds.
"Okay, let's go down and tell Qilin to stop playing."
Ling Hao stood up slowly and said
"Yes"
Then Di Yi appeared outside the palace and looked at the secret realm between the two hundred-foot-high mountains below, as well as the monks outside the secret realm.
Then he patted the Qilin, which made the eight-headed ancient Qilin calm down, and the pressure on his body also dissipated.
At this time, outside the secret realm of True Dragon
"Huh, uh~ Finally... I can finally breathe a sigh of relief."
After the pressure dissipated, the monk below was able to breathe immediately and fell to the ground, still sweating on his head.
Some take drugs to regulate their breathing, and some start practicing internal energy to regulate their bodies.
"It's great. This terrible pressure has finally dissipated. I'm afraid I won't be able to hold on for a while."
Ye Chen in the corner also stood up with difficulty and said, then he drank the elixir in the storage ring, and then began to sit cross-legged to recuperate. As the spiritual energy in the body continued to gather in the Dantian, the soul power in the ring was replenished and nourished the sleeping Tianlao.
"The most urgent task now is to wake up Tianlao, otherwise it will be difficult to handle when the True Dragon Secret Realm opens."
"Sixth Princess, are you okay?"
Commander Xue helped Feng Xueling up and said, feeling very uneasy in his heart. If Feng Xueling had any shortcomings, he would have to raise his head to see the emperor.
"I'm fine, thank you Commander Xue"
Feng Xueling gasped and stood up, looked around, and then looked at the palace in the void.
And above the palace, stood a man wearing golden armor, his whole body exuding extremely strong golden light, like a sun.
"I don't know what kind of power you belong to, but this little girl is the sixth princess of Fengyun Empire, Feng Xueling."
Feng Xueling respectfully faced Emperor Yiyi in the palace, feeling extremely uneasy in her heart.
